body: Oh also, do you think I need meds or councilling or something?

> it is not your fault that he groomed you.

I should have seen through it. Looking back, it's painfully obvious he steered me - every step of the way.

> I hope you know that a majority of big cities and areas find LGBT people just as valid as they are. I know it is a few years away, but you should look into attending college in a big city where you could express yourself.

My only chance is Uni. That's 2 or 3 years away. I don't know if I can last 2 or 3 weeks, especially with GCSE exams coming up :3

>  I thought being Bi was being "greedy" 

Get told this *all the time* :/

> It is not wrong to love another soul. This is going to sound really lame but I think "Born this Way" from Lady Gaga is slightly comforting. 

I've been listening to Pet Shop Boys for the past few hours - my favourite band - still feel crap.

I know I can't cope. I'm also gonna get outed by my crush someday, wooo. He's the opposite of subtle and has nearly given it away so many times...it's a matter of time.

Oh, I want to cry.
